proposals.mechanism: Actual redstone rising edge calls converter.activate server-side. Finds loaded nonempty cursed cage above, computes spread=potency+1/cost5*spread and requires souls strictly greater than cost. Debits real totem tag or online linked player soul balance, then creates native sculk charge cursor at local/relay ground position. Complete own disk pair delegates native spreader save/load plus enchantments through real ModBlockEntity disk bridge. Actual block server ticker calls converter tick then native updateCursors; concrete SculkBlock consumes restored charge to world growth. nearbyRelay intended codec calls are discarded on both read and write, so reference is transient in practice, re-found only by explicit relay lookup paths.
proposals.dedup: Native2c6 already credits finite paid-resource cursor queue, codec/defaults, cap32 and actual growth depletion. Cage6ec already credits same physical totem/online-owner soul debit and full stack custody. Replacing mob-XP input by cage souls while calling the same native owned charge mechanism is a combined existing owner, not a new persistence mechanism. Enchantment potency fields, relay position helper and each growth type are0; recommend0 for whole candidate.
limits: writeNetwork calls NbtUtils.writeBlockPos(nearbyRelay) but does not put returned CompoundTag anywhere. readNetwork calls NbtUtils.readBlockPos(tag) and ignores returned BlockPos. Therefore this code does not restore or serialize nearbyRelay; no valid location roundtrip or durable relay claim.

Converter activate and tick mutate own sculkSpreader without observed setChanged/markUpdated; cage debit marks cage only. This bounded converter/block code has no explicit dirty for cursor mutation. Cannot promise newly changed cursor queue reaches disk absent other chunk-dirty causes; native world chunk flushing not audited.

Cursors capped32 and addCursor silently refuses extra. Soul debit occurs before addCursors with no acknowledgment/refund; full queue can consume souls without retaining new charge. Native2c6 already has analogous excess charge loss.

Source guard requires >cost, not>=cost, leaving exact available amount unusable. Potency decoded via current EnchantmentHelper, no local nonnegative/max validation; integer cost arithmetic not guarded.

Cage getSouls can read online player first or totem otherwise. decreaseSouls has two separate debit branches rather than mutually exclusive else; soul-transfer ITotem type hierarchy and SEHelper actual player capability mechanics not expanded here. Shared cage helper already credited; do not claim exact-once dual-source debit.

checkCage rebuilds transient reference from current block above, not original cage identity. Relay discovery iterates all candidates and keeps last found; no owner/dimension token, nearest selection or clear-on-no-results assurance.

Native load clears only if cursors list exists, limits restored entries32, partial codec errors can drop entries. Concrete sculk growth debits even when setBlock fails. No stronger transactional semantics supplied by converter.

Native mapped source support is local exact-version snapshot already accepted under2c6; no GitHub upstream commit/blob invented. Mod fixedcommit source hashes verified. No native game/build execution or all sculk behaviour subclass audit.
